subject: 2027 Renewal: audit window, log retention and seat commitment
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, tony.jenkins@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — SOC 2 re‑attestation and log retention

Hi Hannah,

As we work toward our January 2027 renewal, our security team has three items we need confirmed to clear internal approvals:

- SOC 2 re‑attestation: we need an updated attestation for the period ending 2026 (or confirmation of your next attestation timeline).
- Retention window for audit logs: our compliance policy prefers 730 days for audit trails storing PHI access events; your product currently documents 365 days. Can Redwood extend to 730 for an enterprise contract?
- Capacity / seat increase: we expect to expand from 12 to 30 seats across our customer success and analytics teams beginning Q1 2027. Will that affect how evidence is collected (e.g., more distributed logging) or pricing?

Could you share a proposed plan and timeline by EOD next week? We also need a copy of the latest SOC 2 report and an example evidence bundle (redacted) for our auditors.

Thanks,
Lisa
Director, Security & Compliance
Acme Health

Attachments: none
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — SOC 2 re‑attestation and log retention

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR: we can support a 730‑day retention as a contract add‑on, we have a SOC 2 attestation for 2025 that we can share now, and we can propose a migration/plan for your seat expansion that minimizes evidence friction. Full plan below.

Plan and next steps:
1) SOC 2 attestation: attached is our 2025 attestation (SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf). We’ll also provide a redacted evidence bundle and a short memo explaining where logs and audit artifacts are stored.
2) Retention: Standard hosted retention is 365 days. We can extend to 730 days under a new retention SLA that will be listed as a paid add‑on — estimated $0.012 per GB/month for archived log shards. We will include this in the contract terms.
3) Evidence collection: to avoid duplicative uploads we recommend using our secure evidence ingest (S3 presigned uploads or SFTP) — see Evidence_Upload_Instructions.pdf attached. For your expected seat growth to 30 seats, we recommend enabling aggregated audit export (daily batch) to your S3 bucket; that keeps per‑token cost flat and centralizes evidence for auditors.
4) Capacity/seat pricing: preliminary estimate included in capacity_sheet_Q3.xlsx attached. For 30 seats we can offer a committed seat discount (see Ben’s note below) and an option for burst capacity for monthly heavy inference periods.
5) Timeline: if we agree by Aug 25 we can lock retention SLA and updated terms into a DocuSign package and schedule evidence uploads the week of Sept 6 to meet your internal audit window.

Would you like a 30‑minute sync this week to walk the plan with your security and procurement teams? I can do Fri 08/14 10:00–11:00 PT.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (application/pdf); Evidence_Upload_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf); capacity_sheet_Q3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — SOC 2 re‑attestation and log retention

Hi all — looping in a bit of compliance detail from our side.

- Evidence access: auditors can be granted time‑bound access to the evidence repository. We prefer a redacted evidence bundle for initial review; full access can be provisioned under an NDA during the audit window.
- Retention SLA mechanics: extension to 730 days will be implemented as a tiered retention policy (hot: 90 days, warm: 275 days, cold archive: remainder). Cold archives are stored encrypted and accessible within 6–12 hours for retrieval requests. We will add an SLA clause for retrieval time and data integrity checks.
- Data residency note: since Acme is US‑based and using our US region, the retention add‑on will be in the US region only. If you need EU/APAC retention we can discuss separate commitments.

I also attached the evidence upload instructions and a short checklist for auditors. If Acme’s auditors require turnaround <24 hours for retrieval we should scope an expedited retrieval add‑on.

— Marissa
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Evidence_Upload_Instructions.pdf
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — SOC 2 re‑attestation and log retention

Lisa — quick commercial note from our side.

- Pricing: For the seat increase (12 → 30) + 730‑day retention add‑on, we can offer a 10% credit on the first three months of committed seats and tiered pricing on retained GB. I’ve attached an updated line‑item in capacity_sheet_Q3.xlsx (same file referenced earlier).
- Terms: Standard renewal term is 12 months. If Acme signs a 24‑month commitment we can amortize the retention cost and offer a lower per‑GB rate.
- Next steps: If you confirm seat counts and retention choice (365 vs 730) by Aug 25 we’ll prepare an updated SOW and DocuSign packet.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: procurement@acmehealth.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>, tony.jenkins@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 17:11:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — SOC 2 re‑attestation and log retention

Ben/Hannah — thanks, this is helpful. Acme confirms:

- Seat commitment: 30 seats starting 2027‑01‑01.
- Retention: we will opt for the 730‑day retention add‑on with standard retrieval SLA (6–12 hours). If possible include the expedited retrieval clause as optional.
- Term: we prefer a 24‑month commitment (to get the lower per‑GB rate).

Please send the finalized SOW and DocuSign links. Also confirm that the SOC 2 attestation you shared is the latest cert we should present to our auditors; if you have an adding memo that maps the attestation controls to your evidence buckets that would be great.

Once we receive the DocuSign packet we will circulate internally for approvals.

Procurement Team
Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com
